```{r}
con_traffic <- DBI::dbConnect(

  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  dbname = "traffic",
  host = Sys.getenv("TRAFFIC_HOST"),
  user = Sys.getenv("TRAFFIC_USER"),
  password = Sys.getenv("TRAFFIC_PWD")
)
```

```{sql, connection = con_traffic, output.var = "temp_output"}

SELECT
  'Oakland' AS PoliceDepartment,
  SUM(1) AS numStops,
  SUM(search_conducted) AS numSearches,
  AVG(search_conducted) AS pctSearches
FROM ca_oakland_2020_04_01

UNION

SELECT
  'San Diego' AS PoliceDepartment,
  SUM(1) AS numStops,
  SUM(search_conducted) AS numSearches,
  AVG(search_conducted) AS pctSearches
FROM ca_san_diego_2020_04_01

UNION

SELECT
  'San Francisco' AS PoliceDepartment,
  SUM(1) AS numStops,
  SUM(search_conducted) AS numSearches,
  AVG(search_conducted) AS pctSearches
FROM ca_san_francisco_2020_04_01

UNION

SELECT
  'San Jose' AS PoliceDepartment,
  SUM(1) AS numStops,
  SUM(search_conducted) AS numSearches,
  AVG(search_conducted) AS pctSearches
FROM ca_san_jose_2020_04_01

UNION

SELECT
  'Stockton' AS PoliceDepartment,
  SUM(1) AS numStops,
  SUM(search_conducted) AS numSearches,
  AVG(search_conducted) AS pctSearches
FROM ca_stockton_2020_04_01

UNION

SELECT
  'State Patrol' AS PoliceDepartment,
  SUM(1) AS numStops,
  SUM(search_conducted) AS numSearches,
  AVG(search_conducted) AS pctSearches
FROM ca_statewide_2023_01_26;
```
